  1. com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard

Uses of Package
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard

Packages that use com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer
The Metro Optimization Engine: scores, ranks, and selects Equinix metros for a deployment from user sites, provider requirements, workloads, and constraints, against live Fabric catalog data.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard
The Deployment Wizard: turns a metro OptimizationResult into an executable DeploymentPlan — Cloud Routers, provider connections, inter-metro backbone links, and routing protocols, with bandwidth-aware profile selection and honestly-reconciled pricing.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model
Value types for the Deployment Wizard — the plan itself and everything it is made of, plus the execution-side inputs and outcomes.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
Rate cards: pluggable sources of unit prices for the design-time cost, savings, and TCO models.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
Live cloud-provider pricing adapters: RateCard implementations that source current data-egress list prices from the providers' public pricing APIs — AwsPriceListRateCard (AWS Price List bulk offers), AzureRetailPricesRateCard (Azure Retail Prices), GcpBillingCatalogRateCard (GCP Cloud Billing Catalog; the only one needing an API key), and OracleCloudPriceListRateCard (OCI Price List).
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.savings
Cloud-egress savings estimation: how much routing a monthly data volume over an Equinix private interconnect saves versus egressing it to the public internet, net of the Equinix interconnect cost.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco
Design-time total-cost-of-ownership comparison across three DeploymentArchetypes — public cloud over the internet, on-premises, and Equinix-interconnected.
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server
The embedded Equinix Intelligence MCP Server — a community Model Context Protocol server, not affiliated with or endorsed by Equinix, and unrelated to Equinix's own private-beta Fabric MCP server.

  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard used by com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
    Class
    Description
    ColocationItem
    An Equinix colocation cost primitive that a RateCard can price — alongside the interconnection rates (connection / cloud router / egress).
    CustomRateCard
    A RateCard whose prices are supplied by the caller — e.g.
    CustomRateCard.Builder
    Fluent builder for a CustomRateCard.
    EgressPath
    The network path data egress takes when leaving a cloud provider.
    EgressRate
    A usage-based data-egress price expressed per gigabyte, tagged with its PriceSource.
    EquinixRateCard
    A RateCard backed by the live Equinix Fabric Pricing API (fabric.prices()); the authoritative source of Equinix-side connection and Cloud Router prices for the cost, savings, and TCO models.
    PriceQuote
    An immutable price for a single resource, split into its monthly-recurring (MRC) and non-recurring (one-time setup, NRC) components, tagged with the PriceSource it was resolved from.
    PriceSource
    Identifies where a PriceQuote came from, so every number in a cost estimate or savings calculation is traceable to its origin and disclaimed appropriately.
    RateCard
    A source of unit prices for the design-time cost, savings, and TCO models.
    ReferenceRateCard
    A RateCard backed by a bundled, dated table of indicative reference figures — published cloud-provider egress rates, interconnect port fees, and on-prem/colocation midpoints — compiled so the value-realization models work out of the box without a live connection or caller-supplied rates.
    Term
    Commitment term for a priced resource.
